correctness.rationale: For compact pair (G×G, diagonal), Borel–Moore chains of the complement with exchange sign are signed C2-coinvariants of relative chains. Simultaneous homotopies preserve diagonal pairs, allowing collapse to a rose. In the rose signed cell model the rectangular and half-square 2-cells have zero signed differential; ranks H_1=b, H_2=b(b+1)/2. Swap of oriented product 2-cells contributes a minus sign, canceled by the sign local system, so transfer lands in the flip-invariant integral tensor lattice D_2(H_1(G)); this is NOT the integral symmetric coinvariant quotient. Degree-one signed transfer is twice a natural generator of (V⊕V)/diagonal, so half-transfer identifies V. Symmetric-square character is (tr(g)^2+tr(g^2))/2. Separately reconstructed signed/untwisted cellular d1,d2 over rationals for interval, triangle cycle, K4: (b,H1,H2) were (0,0,0),(1,1,1),(3,3,6) for sign and untwisted rational groups (0,0),(0,0),(0,3), with d1*d2=0. These finite models corroborate but do not prove naturality for all graphs.
